title: A Protocol for the Extraction
premise: Ivo Vane, a disgraced intelligence analyst fired from three agencies, receives a calendar invite from her dead handler, Mara Quist, summoning her to a meeting that hasn't happened yet. Following the thread, Ivo discovers Mara was investigating 'Extraction' — an operation designed to stage a catastrophic industrial accident that will be blamed on a foreign cell, and Ivo's own fabricated dossier is the linchpin of the cover story. Hunted by the very agency she once served, and forced to trust Elias Brandt, a defector who knew Mara, Ivo must decide whether belonging means loyalty to institutions or to the truth. In the end she exposes the plot at devastating personal cost, walks away with a new identity she chose rather than one assigned to her, and finally unpacks the go-bag.
about_author: Sebastian Kavanagh is a former logistics consultant who spent a decade shuttling between port cities before turning to fiction full-time. He writes thrillers about people trapped between the stories institutions tell and the ones they tell themselves.

chapters.title: The Invitation
chapters.summary: POV: Ivo Vane. Three months after being pushed out of her third agency, Ivo maintains her polished lie of retirement — until a calendar invite arrives from Mara Quist, her handler, dead for two weeks. The meeting is set for tomorrow at a dockside warehouse. Emotional beat: dread sharpening into compulsion; the lie can't hold against the dead speaking.

chapters.title: Warehouse Nine
chapters.summary: POV: Ivo. She goes despite every instinct, finding the warehouse empty except for Mara's hidden dead-drop: a drive containing fragments of an operation called Extraction, and a note warning that Ivo's own old dossier is its foundation. Surveillance teams arrive; she barely escapes. Emotional beat: paranoia igniting into purpose.

chapters.title: What the Dossier Said
chapters.summary: POV: Ivo, with an interlude of Elias Brandt watching her from across the street. Decoding Mara's files, Ivo realizes the fabricated intelligence she wrote years ago — under pressure, half-believing it — is now scheduled to justify a staged industrial disaster. Emotional beat: guilt curdling into resolve; her past sin is the weapon.

chapters.title: The Defector
chapters.summary: POV: alternating Ivo and Elias. Elias Brandt, a former colleague of Mara's now living off-grid, contacts Ivo through a cipher only Mara would know. He claims Mara trusted him with the second half of the files — but his motives are opaque, and someone is feeding the agency Ivo's movements. Emotional beat: wary attraction and mutual suspicion taking root.

chapters.title: Clean Hands
chapters.summary: POV: Deputy Director Sorrel Kane. Inside the agency, Kane — Mara's superior and the architect of Extraction — learns Ivo has the drive and quietly activates the machinery to discredit her: leaked psych evaluations, an arrest warrant, a narrative of a broken analyst gone rogue. Emotional beat: cold institutional menace; duty as a mask for ambition.

chapters.title: Safehouse Arithmetic
chapters.summary: POV: Ivo. Holed up with Elias in a derelict safehouse, Ivo pieces together the target: a chemical plant whose 'accident' will kill hundreds and trigger the policy Mara died trying to stop. Between decoded fragments, she and Elias trade truths about the lives they've performed. Emotional beat: intimacy kindling in the space between fear and honesty.

chapters.title: The Mole in the Room
chapters.summary: POV: Elias, then Ivo. Elias discovers the leak feeding Kane is someone inside Mara's old network — and the evidence points uncomfortably close to himself. When Ivo finds the transmission log, trust fractures; she flees with the drive, alone again by choice. Emotional beat: betrayal's vertigo; love against duty pulling in opposite directions.

chapters.title: Quist's Last Lesson
chapters.summary: POV: Ivo. A final encrypted layer opens using Mara's personal passphrase — which Ivo realizes was always meant for her. Mara's message reveals the mole's identity, the attack's exact timing (thirty-six hours), and a confession: she recruited Ivo years ago knowing her malleable guilt would make her either the perfect scapegoat or the perfect witness. Emotional beat: grief transmuted into clarity.

chapters.title: Extraction Point
chapters.summary: POV: alternating Ivo, Elias, and Kane. Ivo returns to Elias, choosing trust over certainty, and together they race to the plant on the eve of the staged disaster. Kane's team closes in; the saboteurs move on schedule. Ivo must get the evidence out while physically preventing the 'accident' — climax: the plant's failsafes tripped, alarms rising, Kane arriving to tie the bow.

chapters.title: A Protocol for Living
chapters.summary: POV: Ivo, epilogue six weeks later. The disaster is averted but publicly reframed; Kane falls quietly, the institution survives, and Ivo gets no medal — only a new name she picked herself. She meets Elias where nothing is classified, and finally unpacks the go-bag, keeping only what belongs to the person she chose to be. Emotional beat: belonging earned, identity authored, love unclassified.
